# Cleveland Clinic Health Essentials

> > Cleveland Clinic Health Essentials provides evidence-based health and wellness information from Cleveland Clinic medical experts covering conditions, prevention, and treatment strategies.

Health Essentials is Cleveland Clinic's patient education platform offering articles, guides, and resources on diseases, conditions, and wellness topics. The site features content from Cleveland Clinic physicians and specialists across multiple medical disciplines including dermatology, gastroenterology, allergy/immunology, and oral health.

## Key Topics

- Cancer prevention and colorectal health
- Allergies and symptom relief
- Dermatology and skin care
- Oral health and teeth grinding (bruxism)
- Digestive health conditions
- Cold, flu, and respiratory illnesses
- Home remedies and wellness guides
- Eye health
- Adult-onset allergies
- Colon cancer screening
- TMJ disorders
- Health conditions hub pages
- Medical expert contributors
- Patient education resources

## Core Health Condition Hubs

- [Cancer Care & Prevention - Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/health-conditions/cancer-care-prevention): Hub page for cancer care, prevention, and related health conditions.
- [Digestive - Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/health-conditions/digestive-health): Hub page for digestive health and gastrointestinal conditions.
- [Allergies - Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/health-conditions/allergies): Hub page covering allergies, allergy management, and symptom relief.
- [Cold, Flu & Respiratory Illnesses - Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/health-conditions/cold-flu-respiratory-illnesses): Hub page covering cold, flu, RSV, croup, and respiratory illnesses.
- [Skin Care & Beauty - Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/health-conditions/skin-care-beauty): Hub page covering skin care, beauty, and dermatology health conditions.
- [Oral Health - Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/health-conditions/oral-health): Hub page for oral health topics including TMJ, teeth grinding, and dental care.

## Cancer Prevention & Screening

- [The Link Between Alcohol and Cancer](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/alcohol-and-cancer): Article on alcohol as carcinogen and cancer risk reduction strategies.
- [Foods That May Lower Colon Cancer Risk](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/the-best-diet-to-lower-your-colon-cancer-risk-2): Dietary guide for colon cancer prevention by Dr. Scott Steele.
- [How Fast Does Colon Cancer Grow and Progress?](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/how-quickly-do-colon-polyps-turn-cancerous): Timeline of colon cancer development and screening recommendations.
- [How Safe Are Colonoscopies?](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/are-colonoscopies-safe): Safety analysis of colonoscopy procedures by Dr. Arielle Kanters.
- [Should You Try an At-Home Colon Cancer Test?](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/at-home-colon-cancer-test): Comparison of at-home colon cancer tests with colonoscopy procedures.

## Allergies & Symptom Management

- [Can You Develop Allergies Later in Life?](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/can-develop-allergies-later-in-life): Medical explanation of adult-onset allergies by Dr. Lily Pien.
- [Pink Eye vs. Allergies: What Do You Have?](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/pink-eye-vs-allergies): Symptom comparison guide distinguishing pink eye from allergies.
- [Can Allergies Cause a Sore Throat?](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/allergies-cause-sore-throat): Explanation of allergy-related sore throat and symptom relief options.

## Dermatology & Oral Health

- [Does Stress Cause Hair Loss?](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/can-stress-cause-hair-loss): Medical explanation of stress-related hair loss by dermatologist Melissa Piliang, MD.
- [How To Stop Grinding Your Teeth at Night](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/how-to-stop-grinding-teeth): Guide to managing bruxism with mouthguards and stress-relief techniques.

## Home Remedies & Wellness

- [Best Sore Throat Remedies for Fast Recovery](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/sore-throat-remedies-that-actually-work): Home remedies and recovery guide for sore throat by Dr. Amy Zack.

## Optional

- [The Dangers of Rubbing Itchy Eyes](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/dangers-of-rubbing-itchy-eyes): Eye health article explaining risks of rubbing eyes.

## Support & Navigation

- [Cleveland Clinic Health Essentials](https://health.clevelandclinic.org): Homepage offering health and wellness information from Cleveland Clinic experts.
- [Contact Us – Cleveland Clinic](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/contact-us): Contact information and customer support for Health Essentials.
